examShortTricks: Trick 1: Theme in one line: divine justice and forgiveness outweigh human law — Ivan's pardon of Makar is the proof event; quote it.

Trick 2: Irony is the device to name: the title promises God sees the truth but WAITS — 26 years of suffering before truth emerges; explain the double irony (Makar confesses, Aksyonov dies before release).
Trick 3: Character change question: track Aksyonov from carefree merchant to spiritual, resigned prisoner — pick two contrasting moments (early suspicion of wife; final forgiveness).
practiceQuestions: Q. What is the significance of the title? (2 marks) — God knows the truth but his justice comes in his own time; Aksyonov's 26-year wait shows this.
Q. How does Aksyonov change in Siberia? (2 marks) — from a worldly, quick-tempered merchant to a saintly, forgiving man.
keyPoints: Theme: divine justice vs human justice — Aksionov suffers for a crime he did not commit.
The title's meaning: God sees the truth but waits 26 years; forgiveness ends the story.
